description: 2026 U.S. state legislative geographic district maps; source-backed display geometry and audited forecast identity joins.

processing.projection: state-centered Lambert azimuthal equal-area; same frame for both chambers
processing.simplification: topology-aware Douglas-Peucker, no smoothing, at most 50 projected meters; all polygon parts exploded and kept before reassembly

displayGeneralization.multipartPreservation: exploded before simplification, keep-shapes, dissolved by original GEOID
